why_it_matters: Initial inventory rows are unsafe if the basis is guessed
required_evidence_or_check: Review packet states whether the row is policy-based measured or assumption-based
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms one opening-state basis and its limits
fail_or_defer_condition: If the basis is unclear or mixed then defer
notes: Opening-state semantics must be fixed before promotion.

criterion: Unit basis and usable-versus-gross semantics are explicit
why_it_matters: Inventory values are not comparable if stock semantics are unclear
required_evidence_or_check: Check units and whether usable stock differs from gross stock
pass_condition: Reviewer confirms unit and stock semantics are explicit
fail_or_defer_condition: If unit or stock semantics remain ambiguous then defer
notes: This check aligns with the shared unit and endpoint note.

criterion: Weak evidence triggers sensitivity rather than silent base use
why_it_matters: Opening stocks can materially affect apparent flexibility
required_evidence_or_check: Check evidence strength and whether the packet requests sensitivity treatment
pass_condition: Reviewer either approves narrow use with sensitivity or defers
fail_or_defer_condition: If weak evidence is treated as base-case truth then fail
notes: Initial inventories should not be promoted early without a clear basis.
